array.string: if [ ! -f "$HOME/.config/colibri/colibri.env" ] || [ "$(stat -f '%Lp' "$HOME/.config/colibri/colibri.env")" != "600" ]; then echo "Colibri environment file must exist and be mode 600" >&2; exit 78; fi; set -a; . "$HOME/.config/colibri/colibri.env"; set +a; exec /opt/colibri/c/coli serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18000 --model-id glm-5.2-colibri --max-queue 1 --queue-timeout 60
